summary: The deposit changes the booking flow, the stored payment data and what the admin page shows. The earlier confirmation and cancellation behaviour may change.

criteria.text: When the owner cancels a paid booking, the admin page shows that the deposit needs to be refunded by hand.
The admin booking list shows the deposit amount and the payment reference for each booking.

findings.title: Cancelled bookings keep the deposit with no refund note
findings.plain: Cancelling a booking in the admin page removes it but says nothing about the deposit already paid.
findings.costIfIgnored: Customers lose their deposit when the salon cancels, and the owner has no record that a refund is owed.
findings.fixPrompt: When a paid booking is cancelled, store a refund-needed flag and show it on the admin page.
